_what_this_is: Every machine-specific location, declared once. Code reads paths through paths.py and never hardcodes one.
_why_env_overrides: The subject repository and the base weights are on a different volume from this repository, so their paths cannot be relative and must be supplied. An unset override fails loudly rather than falling back to a default that is wrong on this host.
